name: Clipto MCP
description: Indexes terabytes of local video, audio, and images so agents can search them in natural language and pull back timestamped clips. Runs on-device; files never upload.

skills.name: Clip Search
skills.description: Searches indexed local video and audio in natural language, returning matching segments with start and end timestamps.

skills.name: Media Indexing
skills.description: Builds an on-device semantic index across local video, photo, and audio libraries without uploading source files.

skills.name: Rough Cut Assembly
skills.description: Assembles selected clips into a rough cut sequence that editors can open directly in a video editing timeline.
